Hi all,

Thanks again for hosting us this week — great discussions and some clear next steps. Per our wrap-up I pulled together the consolidated notes and an initial action log with owners. Please review the owners and deadlines below and reply with any corrections by EOD Thursday so we can lock the plan and upload the final artifacts to the shared Drive link.

Attachments: lumina-workshop-notes-20260818.pdf (meeting notes, agenda mapping), action-log-20260818.csv (owner + due dates)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C4d5E6F/view?usp=sharing
HubSpot deal: HS-12948

Top-line action items (owners / suggested due):
- Access controls diagram for patient-data workflow — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2026-08-31
- Sizing & autoscaling recommendation for peak hours — Owner: Ben Carter — Due: 2026-09-07
- Follow-up security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence) — Owner: Lumina procurement / CC'd procurement@luminahealth.com — Due: 2026-09-03
- Example playbook for failover routing in cross-region — Owner: Karthik Iyer — Due: 2026-09-10

Requests / asks:
1) Marissa — can you confirm the access-controls owner and whether the diagram should include on-prem HSM details?
2) Ben — please open the initial cost/runbook section in the action log and add recommended instance types so we can validate TCO.
3) Sara / procurement — if you prefer a different owner for SOC2 evidence, flag that line (we set procurement as placeholder).

I'll monitor replies and circulate an updated CSV on Friday morning. If there are any questions, call me directly — I'll be on plane until 19:30 PT but monitoring email.

Thanks,
